name: rrr
description: Create page-cited reviews and claim evaluations from a selected PDF collection.

interface.longDescription: Retrieval-Restricted Reasoning (RRR) creates literature reviews and claim evaluations from a selected folder of PDFs, with page-level evidence and audit artifacts.
defaultPrompt: Use $rrr t1 followed by a claim to evaluate it against my PDFs.
Use $rrr t2 followed by a topic to review my PDFs.
